verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's docs confirm Session Replay exists and lets PMs review why users drop off, but no evidence pack item documents automatic masking of sensitive inputs (e.g., form fields, passwords) by default. Community evidence explicitly states PII like names and emails can slip through session replay, undermining any assumption that masking is enabled by default. missing for 10: documentation of default input masking, PII redaction controls, or first-party statement confirming automatic sensitive-data protection in replays.
